statusHistory.note: Pre-pilot-2 remediation. All 24 product-suite failures reproduced from a prepared local environment before any edit: 1892 passed, 24 failed.

Four root causes derived from source, not from historical labels. RC-1 CRLF text scanning (17), RC-2 path separator in a test helper (1), RC-3 POSIX file mode (2), RC-4 product path.join in captureVault (4).
AD-001 to AD-006 recorded. RC-4 excluded: it is a product defect in biometric capture paths, classified R4, and bundling it would make this whole specification R4.

Artefact set complete for R2, no open clarification. Stops here: R2 specification approval is the author's, the author is an AI, and AGENTS.md forbids self-approval. EVC-017 resolved only the convergence gate, not gate 1.
Gate 1 approved by a human Product Owner. Authorship unchanged. RC-4 explicitly excluded from the approved scope.
TASK-001 to TASK-005, TASK-008 and TASK-009 executed across eight controlled sessions. RC-4 deliberately not touched.
VER-0001 and REV-0001 recorded. Product suite 1913 passed / 4 failed / 3 skipped; the 4 are RC-4. Playwright 5 of 5. B2 93/93, B3 70/70.

Verification remediation. convergence.md recommends FAIL with CONV-004 and CONV-005 OPEN, and SPEC_LIFECYCLE.md states that a FAIL verdict returns the specification to IMPLEMENTING; the transition is also legal under SDD-V018 (VERIFYING -> IMPLEMENTING). No requirement, scope, architecture or security requirement changes, so CHANGE_CONTROL.md requires no CHG- entry. A human instructed a bounded rework covering CONV-004, CONV-005, test-database seed parity, the corresponding tests, traceability and evidence, and re-verification; that instruction is recorded here as the trigger and is NOT an approval record - it discharges no gate. The gate-1 Product Owner approval of 2026-09-08 already covers this scope: it names the bounded Playwright harness remediation and the deterministic master_saas_test bootstrap. Authorship unchanged. RC-4 still excluded.

Rework complete and re-verified. VER-0003: Playwright 5 of 5 with three genuine cold starts; db:test:prepare now CI-equivalent (migrate then seed), proven fresh and idempotent; product suite 1914 passed / 4 failed / 2 skipped from that baseline, and 1913 / 4 / 3 with zero skipped files against a deliberately unseeded catalogue so the permission-race fix stayed proved where the race is possible. REV-0002 reviews the rework delta. CONV-004 and CONV-005 RESOLVED; CONV-006 raised for the gate-1 approver. Three findings remain OPEN and all three are human decisions.

Verdict PASS WITH ACCEPTED LIMITATIONS, accepted by a human at gate 6. No CONV- finding is OPEN: CONV-001 RESOLVED by REV-0004 (human code review), CONV-002 ACCEPTED_RISK with four conditions and a named human owner, CONV-004 and CONV-005 RESOLVED, CONV-006 RESOLVED as a confirmation of existing scope, CONV-003 NOT_APPLICABLE. Two items are carried into the release gate rather than closed here: BLK-007, the POSIX/Linux execution proof required by CONV-002 condition 4; and BUG-004, an intermittent fixed-window race in an unrelated webhook rate-limit test observed during the closure run and registered rather than absorbed. NOT advanced to READY_FOR_RELEASE or RELEASED, and this is not production, staging, deployment or SPEC-0005 approval.

approvals.scope: Gate 6 convergence acceptance of SPEC-0004 at verdict PASS WITH ACCEPTED LIMITATIONS, together with the CONV-002 ACCEPTED_RISK disposition and the CONV-006 scope confirmation.
approvals.note: Per EVC-017, convergence acceptance for an AI-authored R0-R2 specification is exercised by a Qualified Human Reviewer. Decision supplied explicitly in session by a human and transcribed by an agent; the agent did not make it. Explicitly NOT production approval, staging approval, deployment approval or SPEC-0005 approval. CONV-002 condition 4 - proof from a POSIX/Linux execution environment - remains outstanding as a production gate, tracked as BLK-007.

approvals.evidenceRef: SPEC-0004 spec.md; explicit human Gate-1 decision, pre-pilot-2 remediation pass
approvals.scope: RC-1, RC-2, RC-3 remediation; deterministic master_saas_test bootstrap; inaccurate setup-documentation correction; bounded Playwright harness investigation and remediation; associated tests, traceability and evidence.
approvals.note: Does NOT authorize RC-4 biometric capture-vault remediation, authentication redesign, authorization or tenant-boundary changes, production/staging access, deployment, migration outside the isolated local test environment, Pilot #2 implementation, PC-01, or EVC-016 resolution. Authorship is unchanged and remains AI, Planner role.

reviews.note: Discharges the R2 human code-review gate; CONV-001 RESOLVED. Decision given explicitly in session by a human and transcribed by an agent - see REV-0004 provenance note. Does NOT discharge gate 6 convergence acceptance, and does not disposition CONV-002 or CONV-006.
